name: Kanda Myojin Hall
address: Tokyo 101-0021 Kanda Myojin Bunka Koryukan 2F, 2-16-2 Soto-Kanda, Chiyoda-ku
accessSummary: Ochanomizu Station (JR Chuo Line and Sobu Line): 5 min walk / Ochanomizu Station (Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line): 5 min walk / Shin-Ochanomizu Station (Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line): 5 min walk / Suehirocho Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line): 5 min walk / Akihabara Station (JR Keihin-Tohoku Line and Yamanote Line): 7 min walk / Akihabara Station (Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line): 7 min walk
hours: Basic venue fee hours are 9:00-20:00. The period from 20:00 to 9:00 the next day is subject to a time extension fee (approval by the operator required). Use on an hourly usage fee basis is for a minimum of 5 hours. Open every day of the year in principle; reservations are accepted from one year (365 days) before the date of use. Phone reception is on weekdays 10:00-19:00.
notice: Only corporations can enter into a contract; individuals, groups, circles and the like cannot apply (Notes on the Application Procedure, updated August 9, 2025).

rooms.name: Hall (2F)
rooms.note: 17.4 m x 17.4 m. Theater 392 seats and classroom 240 seats are with the portable stage; with the lifting stage, theater is 296 seats and classroom 192 seats (official layout diagrams). Standing party for 300 people; standing concert for 650 people. The maximum number of people is 700 (Terms of Use Article 20). The lifting stage is 13 m wide x 5 m deep x 0 to 1.2 m high, with a 300-inch 16:9 screen. Can be used together with the foyer via a movable partition. Basic venue fee 500,000 yen (9:00-20:00) + facility management fee 50,000 yen (excluding tax, revised April 1, 2026)

rooms.name: Foyer (2F)
rooms.note: Has a cloakroom, a bar counter and restrooms, and connects directly to the outside deck through glass folding doors. Can be used together with the hall via a sliding wall. Included in the basic venue fee (quote sample: "Includes foyer, cloakroom, waiting rooms, etc.")

ops.prevDaySetup: A separate preparation day, such as the day before, can be rented. In the quote sample "Preparation and event, 2 days of use", the preparation day (13:00-18:00) is charged at the hourly usage fee (60,000 yen per hour, minimum 5 hours) and the event day at the basic venue fee (500,000 yen, 9:00-20:00), with the facility management fee for 2 days (50,000 yen per day). In the 3-day exhibition sample, all 3 days are charged at the basic venue fee. The basic venue fee covers 9:00-20:00; preparation, setup and teardown before or after that incur an out-of-hours extension fee (50,000 yen per hour) and require the operator's approval (all of the above excluding tax, per the quote sample dated April 1, 2026).
ops.loadingHours: Load-in and load-out must be done within the usage time. The usage time runs from the start of preparation to the completion of teardown, and teardown is regarded as complete "when the vehicle has left the loading area" (Notes on the Application Procedure, updated August 9, 2025). The loading entrance is 1,500 mm wide x 2,300 mm high. The freight elevator interior is 1,700 mm wide x 2,530 mm deep x 2,350 mm high, with a door opening of 1,700 mm wide x 2,100 mm high, a load capacity of 2,000 kg and a capacity of 30 people (dimension drawing updated May 5, 2025; the Hall Overview and Access page gives a depth of 2,450 mm). The quantity and timing of load-in and load-out must be notified by 1 week before the event. Advance deliveries are limited to one hand truck's worth and, in principle, arrive between 10:00 and 19:00 on the day before use (Basic Rules on Deliveries, updated May 15, 2026).
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is a space shared with other tenants on the 1st floor, and leaving vehicles parked there is strictly prohibited. Leave as soon as the work is finished. Vehicles that can enter the loading area are limited to a height of 4 m and 4-ton trucks; the drawing recommends vehicles up to 2 tons (backing in makes it easier to leave). Vehicles that need to be left parked are moved to the designated parking spaces secured by the venue for up to 2 vehicles (height up to 2.5 m, up to Hiace class, no trucks) (all of the above from the Load-in/Load-out Vehicle List). Notify the quantity and timing of load-in and load-out by 1 week before the event, and if there is a risk of damage, protect the floor and walls with protective covering and restore them to their original condition. The accessory facilities of the exhibition plan (3 days or more) state "Hall space for up to 2 passenger cars".
ops.parking: The hall has no parking lot; use nearby coin parking lots (Access page). The official list of nearby parking lots (9 lots) includes: Times Tokyo Garden Palace (51 spaces), Yours Parking Soto-Kanda No. 1 (7), Mizubayashi Parking (42), TNS Soto-Kanda 3-chome (10), Navipark Yushima No. 2 (21), Akihabara Super Building (42), Akihabara Daibiru (112), Akihabara UDX Parking (785; open 24 hours, height up to 2.4 m, width 2.5 m, length 6 m and weight 2.3 t; 300 yen per 30 minutes, maximum 2,300 yen per 24 hours on weekdays) and Times Akihabara Station Denkigai-guchi (27).
ops.waitingRooms: On the 2nd floor there are 2 dressing rooms (21.7㎡ and 16.6㎡, each for up to about 10 people, with makeup counters) and 2 waiting rooms (4.2㎡ and 3.6㎡, each for up to about 2 people); on the 3rd floor there are 1 organizer's waiting room (7.1㎡, up to about 6 people) and the VIP lounge (38.7㎡, up to about 15 people). There are also a pantry, a smoking room and a back restroom (capacities are from the Exhibition Plan page).
ops.catering: Food and drink are allowed in the hall, the foyer and the waiting rooms. For party meals, the venue introduces a specialist company according to your wishes and budget. Plastic bottles of water and tea can be arranged and added to the venue's invoice. The quote sample states that catering costs are separate; a coffee and cup set is 300 yen per cup and 350 ml mineral water is 130 yen per bottle. Eating, drinking and smoking outside the places designated by the operator is prohibited (Terms of Use Article 20). Catering and food-stall vendors must take their waste (bottles, cans and food waste) back with them (Waste Disposal Guide, updated September 24, 2025).
ops.restaurants: The hall itself can be used for receptions and parties, and the top page states "many past uses for receptions and parties in combination with meetings and seminars" (there are quote samples for a standing party of 300 and for a reception-only half-day use). A banner on the hall's official site also leads to the "Dinner Gatherings & Parties" page of the Myojin Kaikan of Kanda Shrine (Japanese cuisine x French, small groups up to 120 people).
